name: Project Based Learning
summary: List of programming tutorials that build an app from scratch, grouped into 24 language and tech categories.
description: A curated list of project-based programming tutorials in which developers learn by building an application from scratch. Entries are grouped into 24 categories based on the first technology listed — from C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Python, Java, Kotlin, Swift and Ruby to HTML/CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native and Dart/Flutter — and link out to external tutorials, books and video series for web apps, games, servers, databases and emulators.
contains: entries link to external tutorials, books and video courses
examples: build a database, OS, compiler, chat app, blog, emulator
